test_title: PYST 58: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 23 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question: Four sentences are given, out of which three have all correct spellings. Choose the sentence with the incorrect spel word/ words.

options.text: He unlocked the door, and I cleared out up the river-bank.
I noticed some pieces of limbs and such things floating down, and a sprinkling of bark
I reckonned I wouldn't stay on hand till he got that chance.
I went along up the bank with one eye out for pap and the other one out for what the rise might fetch along

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word "reckonned" is incorrect. The correct spelling is **"reckoned"**. • **"Reckoned"** means to consider or regard in a specified way. (विचार करना) • **Correct Example: **I reckoned it was time to leave. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1:** He unlocked the door, and I cleared out up the river-bank. (उसने दरवाजा खोला, और मैं नदी के किनारे साफ हो गया।) • **Example:** He unlocked the door, and I cleared out up the river-bank. • **Option 2:** I noticed some pieces of limbs and such things floating down, and a sprinkling of bark. (मैंने देखा कि कुछ अंगों के टुकड़े और ऐसी चीजें नीचे तैर रही थीं, और छाल का छिड़काव।) • **Example:** I noticed some pieces of limbs and such things floating down, and a sprinkling of bark. • **Option 4:** I went along up the bank with one eye out for pap and the other one out for what the rise might fetch along. (मैं बैंक के साथ ऊपर चला गया एक आंख पाप के लिए और दूसरी आंख इस पर कि वृद्धि क्या ला सकती है।) • **Example:** I went along up the bank with one eye out for pap and the other one out for what the rise might fetch along. 3d:Tac7, The correct answer is '**across**'.
